metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2026 · Drummer Boy
metas.description: As America’s fight for independence begins, a young drummer boy, an enslaved woman, and a divided family search for freedom. Through battle and loss, music carries hope in a deeply human story of faith and forgiveness.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2026 · NAZA
metas.description: Filmed at night from Tel Aviv rooftops, this investigative documentary examines the civilian casualties of Israel's military operations in Gaza and the systems behind targeted killings of Palestinians.
